title: Florida Senate, District 2
what_it_does: Represents District 2 in the Florida Senate; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: WUWF's June 12, 2026 qualifying wrap-up reports that in SD 2 Republican incumbent Jay Trumbull qualified along with Democrat Lauren Donahoo; Ballotpedia lists Trumbull as running in the Nov. 3, 2026 general election (https://www.wuwf.org/local-news/2026-06-12/the-field-is-set-as-candidate-qualifying-closes-for-floridas-2026-election; https://ballotpedia.org/Florida_State_Senate_District_2). County list is from general knowledge of the 2022 map and was NOT verified by a snippet. Research limitation (Sept 2026): Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, dos.fl.gov, floridaelectionwatch.gov, Florida Politics and all news sites were blocked for fetching in this sandbox and the WebSearch budget was capped, so the roster is built only from search-result snippets; write-in/NPA qualifiers could not be checked. Positions are null because no snippet contained an explicit issue statement.

candidates.name: Jay Trumbull
candidates.photo_source: Florida Senate member page (portrait image URL not verified; site blocked in sandbox)
candidates.background: Trumbull, a Panama City Republican, has represented Senate District 2 since Nov. 8, 2022 after serving in the Florida House. He qualified for re-election in June 2026.
candidates.primary_result: No Republican primary opponent reported; qualified June 2026 (WUWF).
